newsitem.title: USA: NHL ice hockey-KINGS' GOALTENDER FISET OUT INDEFINITELY.
newsitem.headline: NHL ice hockey-KINGS' GOALTENDER FISET OUT INDEFINITELY.

text.p: Los Angeles Kings goaltender Stephane Fiset will be sidelined indefinitely after suffering an abdominal-groin strain in Tuesday's loss at Edmonton, the team said Thursday.

The team is listing Fiset's status as "week-to-week" but he could be out up to a month. He was injured in the first period against Edmonton and was replaced by Byron Dafoe, who finished up the 4-1 loss.
The 26-year-old Fiset is 13-23-5 with a 3.17 goals-against average in 43 games. Tuesday's loss ended his personal five-game winning streak, which included a pair of shutout victories over Vancouver.

The Kings on Thursday recalled Jamie Storr from Phoenix of the International Hockey League, where he was 14-20-4 with a 3.64 goals against average in 39 games. The 21-year-old Storr was the seventh overall pick in the 1994 draft.
